name: PoetryDB
summary: Keyless API for public-domain poems in English, searchable by author, title, line text and line count.
description: PoetryDB serves the full text of classic English-language poems from public-domain editions (largely Project Gutenberg), with author, title, lines, line count and source edition. URL paths combine input fields (author, title, lines, linecount, poemcount, random) with optional output fields and a json or text format, so one request can ask for, say, all 14-line Shakespeare poems. Authors also have a structured biography endpoint.

endpoints.summary: Poems by an author (partial match unless :abs); optional output fields and text format
Combine input fields (author, title, lines, linecount, poemcount, random); terms separated by semicolons
Structured author biography with notable poems

license.name: CC BY 4.0 for the curated database (poem texts themselves are public domain); code GPL-2.0

agent_notes: Everything is in the path, not the query string: /<input fields>/<terms>[/<output fields>][.text]. Several input fields with the same number of terms are ANDed; several fields with one term are ORed. Append :abs to a term for an exact match. URL-encode spaces in names and titles.
caveats: No matches returns HTTP 200 with {"status":404,"reason":"Not found"}, so check the body, not only the status code.
Semicolons separate search terms and cannot be searched for.
Run by a single maintainer; no uptime or rate-limit commitments are published.

hn.title: PoetryDB – Poetry API for internet poets
